== Astrography and Planetology == 
Guru is a member of the [[Shegimuud Trace]].

=== Stellar Data ===
The Guru System is centered on a cool red star called [[Sage (star)|Sage]]. Guru and its satellite ''Delphi'' are the only major bodies, orbiting at 0.2AU.
 
{{MonostellarSystem
|name           = Guru
|primary        = M1 V 
|PrimaryName    = Sage
}}

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
The system is divided into three major power blocs who each control regions of Guru and Delphi. The largest state is the [[Republic of Arasht]], an impersonal bureaucracy headed by a military junta with a poor [[sophont]]s rights record. It is opposed by [[Berengeria]] and [[Pavax]], two closely allied democracies. Both are technologically advanced but neither is powerful enough to independently face Arasht.

In the [[700s]] the tensions between the three nations began to increase. Informed observers began to predict open warfare. By [[1110]] the tensions had reached all time highs, with draconian new security measures implemented in all three countries, and all three nations have begun military build-ups and maneuvers along their respective borders.
